project_decision_2026_10_01.organizer_route_reuse_assumption: Official organizer files supplied as 2026 downloads with internal 2025 names are treated as unchanged 2025-2026 routes for 5, 10, 21 and 43 km.
project_decision_2026_10_01.ultra85: Keep 2026 organizer route separate until geometry comparison establishes equivalence with 2025.

rule: Owner accepted the normalized participant-derived GPX for year-scoped course display (2021–2025). Official organizer status and cross-year performance comparability remain separate claims.

project_decision_2026_10_02.owner_acceptance: Owner confirms 2021–2025 participant GPX tracks were verified and both normalized course-family GPX files are accepted for historical cartographic display. No additional organizer verification is needed for this limited use.
project_decision_2026_10_02.source_integrity: Use the previously produced exact normalized files with SHA-256 pinned in normalized_route_candidates. Do not infer geometry from file size, point count or measured length and do not replace participant evidence with an invented track.
project_decision_2026_10_02.display_semantics: Accepted normalized participant-derived display course. Not OFFICIAL_ORGANIZER. Retain 2024 existing year-specific participant asset until normalized display source is imported. Preserve 2025 organizer route and its provenance; do not silently replace it.
project_decision_2026_10_02.timing_semantics: Map availability independent of split coverage; compute actual timing statistics on observed monotonic EQ Timing endpoint pairs only; do not manufacture checkpoint times or project runner's observed GPS coordinates.
